title: Successful user login with valid credentials
description: Verify that users can log in successfully using valid credentials through Supabase Auth on the login screen.

steps.description: Navigate to the login screen.
Enter valid username/email and password.
Click the login button.
Verify user is authenticated and redirected to the dashboard.

title: Failed login with invalid credentials
description: Verify that login fails and appropriate error message is shown when invalid credentials are submitted.

steps.description: Navigate to the login screen.
Enter invalid username/email and/or password.
Click the login button.
Verify login failure and display of error message indicating invalid credentials.

title: Custom auto-login on specialized domains
description: Verify that users accessing the application from specialized domains are automatically logged in without manual authentication steps.

steps.description: Access the web application via a specialized domain configured for auto-login.
Verify that user is automatically authenticated and taken to the dashboard without requiring manual login.

title: Admin Panel: Add new school
description: Verify administrators can add a new school with valid data via the Admin Panel.

steps.description: Log in as an administrator.
Navigate to the Admin Panel and open the 'Add School' form.
Fill in valid school details (name, address, contact info).
Submit the form.
Verify the new school is listed in the schools management table with accurate details.

title: Admin Panel: Edit existing user details
description: Verify administrator can successfully update details of an existing user including role changes and contact info.

steps.description: Log in as an administrator.
Navigate to the Admin Panel and select an existing user from the user list.
Modify user details such as name, email, and role.
Submit the changes.
Verify the user details are updated correctly and saved in the system.

title: Admin Panel: Prevent invalid school creation
description: Verify that attempting to create a school with missing mandatory fields results in validation errors and prevents submission.

steps.description: Log in as an administrator.
Navigate to 'Add School' in Admin Panel.
Leave mandatory fields empty or enter invalid data.
Attempt to submit the form.
Verify that form submission is blocked and appropriate validation error messages are displayed.

title: School data integration: Add and retrieve school info
description: Verify school data can be added and later retrieved correctly via School Management services API.

steps.description: Use the schoolService API to add a new school with valid data.
Retrieve school data using schoolService API.
Verify the retrieved school data matches the data originally submitted.

title: PDI: Create Individual Development Plan successfully
description: Verify users can create a new Individual Development Plan for a student with complete and valid data.

steps.description: Log in as a teacher or planner.
Navigate to PDI management module.
Create a new PDI with valid input fields including goals, interventions, and timelines.
Submit the PDI.
Verify the new PDI is saved and visible in the student's profile.

title: PDI: Update existing Individual Development Plan
description: Verify users can update information of an existing PDI and changes are saved correctly.

steps.description: Navigate to an existing student's PDI.
Modify some fields such as goals and timelines.
Save the changes.
Verify that the updates persist and display correctly on retrieval.

title: PDI: Delete an Individual Development Plan
description: Verify that a user can delete an Individual Development Plan and that it is removed from the system.

steps.description: Access an existing PDI.
Perform the delete action on the PDI.
Verify the PDI is no longer listed or accessible in the student's profile.

title: Planning Module: Create a new lesson plan
description: Verify teachers or planners can create a new lesson plan with all required content including objectives and materials.

steps.description: Log in as a planner or teacher.
Navigate to the Planning module and open the new lesson plan form.
Enter lesson plan details including title, objectives, materials, and schedule.
Submit and save the lesson plan.
Verify the lesson plan is saved and appears correctly in the list of lesson plans.

title: Planning Module: Adjust and update an existing lesson plan
description: Verify that lesson plans can be updated by editing their contents and changes are saved correctly.

steps.description: Select an existing lesson plan.
Edit its fields such as objectives or scheduling.
Save the updated lesson plan.
Verify the lesson plan changes persist and display properly.

title: Planning Module: Simulate curriculum scenarios successfully
description: Verify that users can simulate lesson plans and curriculum scenarios within the Simulation Workspace module without errors.

steps.description: Navigate to the Simulation Workspace.
Select lesson plans and curriculum modules to run simulation.
Trigger the simulation process.
Verify the simulation completes successfully and provides expected feedback and scenario outputs.

title: Planning Module: Handle invalid lesson plan inputs
description: Verify validation prevents creation of lesson plans with missing mandatory fields or invalid data formats.

steps.description: Open new lesson plan form.
Attempt to submit with missing required fields or invalid values.
Verify appropriate inline validation messages are displayed and submission is blocked.
